reachable: yes (HTTP 200; www.lightingspot26.com connection reset - use bare domain). Occasional proxy tunnel drops; retry worked

Several samples use a different notation than the site: LSH-FL300W-5K vs LS-H-FL-300W-50K, LS2-WMB-301-3K vs LS-2-WMB-301-30K, LS26-GLTR36W1X4CCT3 vs LS-GLTR-36W-1X4-3-CCT, LS26-DL4-10W-4K vs LS26-DL-4INCH-10W-4K, LSJ-2-D202-5K vs LS-J-D202, LSL-2-240-27K vs LS-L-2-240, LS26-GU10-COB-7W vs LS-GU10-COB-7W-<CCT>K; LS-SC-KIT-4-BL had no candidate; LS-CS-6SQTL-S-24W-5CCT-BL only as LS-CS-6SQTL-S-24W-5CCT (no color suffix).

recommended_strategy: Harvest all 9 pages of the WC Store API (823 products) and index by normalized product name and slug (uppercase, strip '-'/'_'). Match: exact name -> normalized -> rule-based (LS26 prefix vs LS, LSH/LS2/LSJ/LSL -> LS-H/LS-2/LS-J/LS-L, CCT '5K'->'50K','3K'->'30K', '-BL'/'-WH' color suffix dropped, DL4 -> DL-4INCH); use images[0].src (WP originals, some '-scaled'). Expect a meaningful share of the 886 SKUs to need manual mapping or to be absent (only ~4/12 matched automatically).
blockers: SKU naming mismatch between Lumera SKU list and manufacturer site (no reliable SKU field). 20 of 823 products have no image.
